title: ASML CEO Christophe Fouquet argues against cutting China off, warning that aggressive export controls will drive Beijing to accelerate domestic development (Reed Albergotti/Semafor)
summary: Reed Albergotti / Semafor: ASML CEO Christophe Fouquet argues against cutting China off, warning that aggressive export controls will drive Beijing to accelerate domestic development — Export controls on chips and other technology shouldn't aim to cut China off completely — a strategy that will only backfire …
